svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: aj is group plus bin over a sorted table
svg.desc: One trade, AAPL at 10:00:03, is matched in two steps against a quote table sorted by sym then time. The sorted table has five rows: row 0 AAPL 10:00:00 bid 99; row 1 AAPL 10:00:02 bid 99.1; row 2 AAPL 10:00:05 bid 99.4; row 3 MSFT 10:00:01 bid 200; row 4 MSFT 10:00:04 bid 200.3. Brackets mark the AAPL rows 0 to 2 as one block and the MSFT rows 3 and 4 as another. Step one, group, is equality on sym: looking up AAPL returns rows 0 1 2, the whole block, without scanning. Step two, bin, is the as-of search on time: within that block the times are 10:00:00, 10:00:02 and 10:00:05, and bin of 10:00:03 returns position 1, the last time at or before the trade, which is row 1, bid 99.1. At the bottom: the sort sym then time is what makes both steps work, because sym first makes each symbol one contiguous block for the group step to return, and time second makes each block ascending so bin returns the right row. In q the whole thing is written aj with the columns sym and time: equality on every column but the last, as-of on the last.
svg.text: Two primitives, over a table sorted for them.

g.text: sym first → each symbol is one contiguous block for step 1 to return. (Speed; `g# records this half.)
time second → each block is ascending, so step 2 returns the right row. (Correctness; nothing records this half.)
